## John

**Identity/family:** John is married and has children, including one-year-old son Kyle and daughter Sara. Family is his “rock”; they enjoy parks, picnics, playgrounds, board games, movie nights, hiking, climbing, concerts, beaches and live music. Former dog Max died after 10 years with the family (June 2023); they considered adopting a rescue dog.

**Work/study:** John graduated from a university degree program (late March 2023; subject unknown). He worked at a mechanical-engineering company, became an assistant manager (June 2023), then lost the job when the company went under (August 2023). He was exploring technology/hardware roles. He blogs and researches politics and policy, especially education reform and infrastructure.

**Activities/interests:** Kickboxing, taekwondo, yoga, weight training, boot camps, walking, camping, mountaineering, hiking, sunsets, photography, and possibly rock climbing. He joined a service-focused group, mentors at a school, volunteers with a firefighting brigade, supports veterans, and participates in community food drives and fundraising.

**Values/goals:** John wants to serve his community/country through local politics or policymaking. His priorities are properly funded schools, safer infrastructure, affordable housing, better living conditions, opportunity for underserved people, and veterans’ rights. He values kindness, service, teamwork, resilience, family, and practical action.

**Timeline:**  
- **Dec 2022:** Family road trip; began political networking; joined a service group; failed a military aptitude test.  
- **Jan–Feb 2023:** Community meetings and education advocacy; food-drive work; ran for office again.  
- **Mar–Apr:** Retook the aptitude test; graduated; began yoga; volunteered at a school career fair; started a politics blog.  
- **May–Jun:** Planned infrastructure work and a veterans’ petition/event; promoted at work; family boot camps; Max died.  
- **Jul:** Flood strengthened his infrastructure campaign; visited a veterans’ hospital; joined firefighting and helped rescue a family from a burning building.  
- **Aug:** Lost his job, mentored students, and helped raise donations for a fire station and new fire truck.

## Maria

**Identity/family/relationships:** Maria has a small family, is close to friends, siblings and her mother, and values mutual support. Her grandmother died between **27 February–5 March 2023**. She joined a church in May 2023 and made friends through volunteering, church and the gym.

**Work/service:** Maria has volunteered at a homeless shelter since about **August 2022**, serving meals, giving talks, helping at children’s events, organizing meals and fundraisers, and working the front desk. She also joined a dog shelter monthly. She helped people including David (housing referral), a displaced cousin, and shelter residents. She received a volunteer medal (August 2023).

**Interests/possessions:** Aerial and kundalini yoga, gym workouts, walking, hiking, camping, music, creative writing, poetry, movies, game nights, baking (peach cobbler, cakes, desserts), travel, photography, sunsets, nature and surfing. She owns a cross necklace and dogs Coco (acquired July 2023) and Shadow (adopted August 2023); she also has another dog.

**Values/goals:** Maria believes in compassion, listening, trust, genuine connection, gratitude, faith, kindness and small acts that create meaningful change. She wants to keep volunteering, explore more shelters, support John’s community projects, and improve lives.

- **2022:** Solo Spain trip and first surfing experience; began shelter volunteering; road trip to Oregon.  
- **Dec 2022–Feb 2023:** Began aerial yoga; donated her old car; helped at children’s and charity events; took creative-writing classes.
